capabilities: Open local folder in Windows Explorer
extras: Requires Windows 11 and depends on Obsidian's internal file explorer DOM structure.
intentEvidence: It adds a small button to each folder row in Obsidian's file explorer.
problem: Users need a quick way to access the underlying operating system folder corresponding to a selected vault directory without leaving the Obsidian interface.
summary: Adds a button to each folder row in Obsidian's file explorer to open the corresponding local folder directly in Windows Explorer.
